name: Build & Survive
detailed_description:
🌍 Welcome to Build & Survive – a vast, dynamic sandbox survival game where every action matters.

In the heart of an uncharted land, you are dropped with nothing but your will to survive. No tutorials, no handholding — only raw nature, relentless enemies, and your ability to adapt. Build & Survive offers a deep and rewarding sandbox experience where your choices shape your destiny. Whether you're chopping trees, crafting tools, defending your base, or fishing at sunrise, survival is always one step away from failure.

Start with the basics — survive with your hands.
At first, the only thing between you and death is a tree. With primitive tools, begin your journey by chopping wood. This simple act lays the foundation for your shelter, tools, and future advancements. Every tree you cut not only gives you materials but changes the environment — a world that lives, grows, and reacts to your actions. Forests will thin out, paths will open, and nature will fight back.

Crafting is survival.

Gather stone, wood, fiber, and other raw resources to craft your first set of gear. From crude axes to reinforced walls, the crafting system in Build & Survive is intuitive yet deep, allowing for dozens of custom recipes and combinations. Build campfires for warmth, storage boxes to hoard supplies, and workbenches to unlock more advanced blueprints. As you progress, you'll unlock technology trees that let you build automated systems, defensive traps, and tools for survival in increasingly harsh conditions.

But nature is not your only enemy.

As day turns to night, waves of increasingly aggressive enemies rise from the shadows. They don’t wait for you to be ready. They destroy what you build. Some strike fast and disappear, others swarm in groups, testing your defenses. Each wave is procedurally generated, adapting to your tactics and base layout. You must evolve, reinforce, and constantly prepare for what’s coming. Strategic defense building is not optional — it’s survival.

Build your home, your fortress, your empire.

Don’t just survive — thrive. Shape the land around you as you expand your base, reinforce it with walls, gates, towers, and automated turrets. Claim land, redirect rivers, flatten mountains, and raise massive structures that stand as a symbol of your progress. Every plank placed and every stone laid matters. You can build underground bunkers, cliffside shelters, or open field strongholds. The choice is yours — the results are permanent.

Slow down. Breathe. Survive with patience.

Sometimes survival isn’t about the next wave — it’s about sustainability. Head to rivers, lakes, or coastal waters and cast your line. Fishing is more than a side activity; it's a vital source of food, health regeneration, and even rare items hidden in the depths. Build fishing huts, smoke your catches for long-term storage, and discover unique fish species across different biomes. In a world full of chaos, fishing offers a rare moment of peace — and a valuable path to survival.

🧭 Explore, expand, and endure.
Beyond your base lies a massive procedurally generated world filled with biomes, secrets, and dangers. Explore desert ruins, snowy peaks, dark caves, and ancient structures. Each environment brings unique resources and challenges. Will you dare to leave the safety of your camp?

🧠 Customize your playstyle.
Want to be a lone wolf with traps and long-range weapons? Or a builder focused on crafting, trading, and farming? The game supports multiple playstyles with dynamic progression systems. Tailor your journey — the game won't stop you.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer coming soon.
The game is being prepared for co-op play — survive with friends, split responsibilities, and defend your camp together. Future updates will include shared bases, trading mechanics, PvP elements, and community events.

🔥 Do you have what it takes to survive when the world pushes back?
Adapt to a living ecosystem. Fight the darkness. Build your legacy. Or be forgotten in the ashes of your broken camp.

⚔️ Are you ready to Build... and Survive?

short_description: Build, craft, and survive in an endless sandbox world filled with danger. Gather resources, fight enemies, and upgrade your base as threats grow stronger. Will you endure or fall in this fast-paced survival challenge?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400/AMD FX-8320 or better
  • Memory: 8,192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 2GB/AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
